verdict.rationale: mise's own commands act on many items at once. `mise use node@24 python@3.14` installs and records several tools in one call, and `mise install` installs every tool declared in config. Dependency-only tasks run their prerequisites in parallel, `mise bootstrap` applies a whole machine's packages, dotfiles, repos and services in one pass, and `mise lock --bump` updates many entries together. None of this is framed as a general bulk-operations feature with selection or filtering across arbitrary items. missing for 10: an explicit bulk/batch mechanism with item selection or filters, documented upgrade-all across tools, batch result reporting, independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk use.
